payload.intro: Berty and I see so many Lunar mages. I teach them a teleport, if they ask me nicely!
payload.prompt: Which teleport spell do I teach Lunar mages?
payload.explanation: With Lunar Diplomacy done, 71 Magic and the Lunar spellbook active, Baba Yaga teaches you Ourania Teleport.

payload.intro: Nature runes, nature runes! The better you get, the more each essence gives you.
payload.prompt: At what Runecraft level do you always craft two nature runes per essence?
payload.explanation: Nature runes need 44 Runecraft, and from 91 every pure essence makes two.

payload.intro: Turn a thing into gold, dearie! Fire runes, yes, but what else?
payload.prompt: Besides fire runes, which rune does High Level Alchemy need?
payload.explanation: High Level Alchemy takes five fire runes and one nature rune, and turns an item into coins.

payload.intro: Berty and I peeked into the Temple of the Eye once. Such a commotion down there!
payload.prompt: Which minigame takes place in the Temple of the Eye?
payload.explanation: Guardians of the Rift is the Runecraft minigame in the Temple of the Eye, where you craft runes to power the Great Guardian.

payload.intro: Moonclan mages are so vengeful! But how much Magic does it take to strike back?
payload.prompt: What Magic level do you need to cast Vengeance?
payload.explanation: Vengeance is a level 94 Lunar spell that sends 75% of the next hit you take back at the attacker.

payload.intro: You sweeties can only hold so many things in your 28-slot inventory. Luckily there are some solutions for that!
payload.prompt: How many runes of each type can a rune pouch or divine rune pouch hold?

payload.intro: Ah! Don't you love teleportation? I could teleport you off this island right now!
payload.prompt: Which of these teleport spells from the standard spellbook have multiple possible destinations?
payload.explanation: The Watchtower, Varrock, and Camelot teleports gain a second teleport option through the achievement diaries.

payload.intro: Little pouches, bigger pouches! Sew them together and carry all the essence your back can bear, dearie!
payload.prompt: Order these five Runecraft essence pouches by the Runecraft level required to use them, from lowest to highest.
payload.explanation: Small pouches require level 1, medium 25, large 50, giant 75 and the combined colossal pouch requires 85 Runecraft.

payload.intro: The Mysterious Ruins are scattered all across the world, dearie! Don't bring your Air talisman to the desert!
payload.prompt: Match each Runecraft altar's mysterious ruins to where it is found.
payload.explanation: Each mysterious ruin stands in its own region: Fire outside Al Kharid, Nature in Karamja, Law on Entrana, Cosmic in southern Zanaris and Body near the Monastery.

payload.intro: Four great spellbooks exist in Gielinor, dearie! Do you remember which tome holds which incantation?
payload.prompt: Sort these spells by the spellbook they belong to.
payload.explanation: Bones to Peaches is on the Standard spellbook, Blood Barrage on Ancient Magicks, NPC Contact and Humidify on the Lunar spellbook, and thrall summoning and Death Charge on the Arceuus spellbook.

payload.intro: Everyone stares at my house's lovely chicken legs, dearie, and nobody ever asks his name! Have you met him?
payload.prompt: What is the name of Baba Yaga's chicken-legged house?
payload.explanation: Baba Yaga's animated chicken-legged house on Lunar Isle is named Berty.

payload.intro: Why carry both air and earth runes when you can bind them together at the altar, hee hee?
payload.prompt: Which combination rune is crafted by combining air and earth?
payload.explanation: Air and earth make dust runes, water and earth make mud runes, air and water make mist runes, and air and fire make smoke runes.

payload.intro: When mages run short of astral runes, they come knocking at my door to buy my stock by the pack!
payload.prompt: How many astral runes are inside one astral rune pack sold in Baba Yaga's Magic Shop?
payload.explanation: Like other rune packs sold in magic shops across Gielinor, each astral rune pack contains 100 astral runes.
